module.name: scmultipick
module.description: Multi-phase detection and picking on waveforms (P and S phases). Automatic seismic phase picking using multiple picker algorithms with enhanced AIC capabilities.

parameter.name: ringBufferSize
parameter.description: Size of the ring buffer in seconds

parameter.name: useAllStreams
parameter.description: Create a picker for every stream data is received for

parameter.name: sensitivityCorrection
parameter.description: Enable sensitivity correction (convert counts to physical units m/s)

parameter.name: calculateAmplitudes
parameter.description: Enables/disables amplitude calculation

parameter.name: defaultChannel
parameter.description: The default channel to pick on for a station without component code

parameter.name: defaultFilter
parameter.description: The default filter when no per station configuration has been read

parameter.name: defaultSFilter
parameter.description: The default filter for S-phase picking on horizontal components

parameter.name: defaultTimeCorrection
parameter.description: The default time correction in seconds to apply when a pick is going to be emitted

parameter.name: leadTime
parameter.description: The timespan in seconds that will be subtracted from NOW to acquire records

parameter.name: initTime
parameter.description: The initialization time per stream in seconds after the first record has been received

group.name: thresholds
group.description: Threshold parameters for the primary picker.

parameter.name: triggerOn
parameter.description: For which value on the filtered waveforms is a pick detected. Station specific values override this value.

parameter.name: triggerOff
parameter.description: The value the filtered waveforms must reach to enable detection again. Between triggerOn and triggerOff the picker is blind and does not produce picks. Station specific values override this value.

parameter.name: deadTime
parameter.description: The time used together with measured amplitude and `thresholds.minAmplOffset` for scaling the amplitude below which the picker is inactive after a P pick.

parameter.name: maxGapLength
parameter.description: The maximum gap length in seconds to handle. Gaps larger than this will cause the picker to be reset.

parameter.name: amplMaxTimeWindow
parameter.description: The time window used to compute a maximum (snr) amplitude on the filtered waveforms.

parameter.name: minAmplOffset
parameter.description: The amplitude used together with measured amplitude and `thresholds.deadTime` for scaling the amplitude below which the picker is inactive after a P pick. The value is typically similar to the trigger threshold.

parameter.name: minDuration
parameter.description: The minimum duration to reach. The duration is measured as the time between trigger on and trigger off. If this value is configured, the detection (pick) will be delayed in order to compute and check the duration.

parameter.name: maxDuration
parameter.description: The maximum duration allowed. The duration is measured as the time between trigger on and trigger off. If this value is configured, the detection (pick) will be delayed in order to compute and check the duration. Negative values deactivate the check.

parameter.name: phaseHint
parameter.description: The phase hint for primary picks

parameter.name: secondaryPhaseHint
parameter.description: The phase hint for secondary picks

parameter.name: picker
parameter.description: The picker type to use for primary phase detection

parameter.name: spickerType
parameter.description: The secondary picker type to use for S-phase detection

parameter.name: killPendingSPickers
parameter.description: Whether to kill previously started secondary pickers when a new primary pick has been declared

parameter.name: multipick.enablePPhases
parameter.description: Enable/disable P-phase picking

parameter.name: multipick.enableSPhases
parameter.description: Enable/disable S-phase picking

parameter.name: multipick.enableRegionalPhases
parameter.description: Enable/disable regional phase picking (Pg, Sg, etc.)

parameter.name: multipick.enableCorePhases
parameter.description: Enable/disable core phase picking (PKP, PKIKP, etc.)

parameter.name: multipick.phaseClassificationMethod
parameter.description: Phase classification method: "auto", "component", "polarization"

parameter.name: multipick.minSPhaseSNR
parameter.description: Minimum SNR for S-phase detection

parameter.name: multipick.minPPhaseSNR
parameter.description: Minimum SNR for P-phase detection

parameter.name: multipick.sPhaseSearchWindow
parameter.description: Time window for S-phase search after P pick (seconds)

parameter.name: multipick.minPSTimeDiff
parameter.description: Minimum P-S time difference (seconds)

parameter.name: multipick.autoPhaseByComponent
parameter.description: Enable automatic phase identification based on component (BHZ -> P, BHN/BHE -> S)

parameter.name: multipick.useAmplitudeRatio
parameter.description: Use amplitude ratio for phase classification (H/V ratio)

parameter.name: multipick.vhRatioThreshold
parameter.description: Expected V/H amplitude ratio threshold for P vs S

parameter.name: multipick.usePolarization
parameter.description: Enable polarization analysis for phase classification

parameter.name: multipick.maxRegionalDistance
parameter.description: Maximum distance for regional phase classification (degrees)

parameter.name: multipick.minTeleseismicDistance
parameter.description: Minimum distance for teleseismic phase classification (degrees)

parameter.name: multipick.sFilter
parameter.description: S-phase filter (if different from P-phase filter)

parameter.name: multipick.sTriggerOnThreshold
parameter.description: S-phase trigger on threshold (if different from P-phase)

parameter.name: multipick.sTriggerOffThreshold
parameter.description: S-phase trigger off threshold (if different from P-phase)

parameter.name: multipick.sTimeCorrection
parameter.description: S-phase time correction (if different from P-phase)

parameter.name: multipick.sTriggerDeadTime
parameter.description: S-phase dead time

parameter.name: useEnhancedAICPicker
parameter.description: Enable enhanced AIC picker with two-pass approach and confidence weighting

parameter.name: multipick.aicMarginMin
parameter.description: Minimum margin for AIC picker window

parameter.name: multipick.aicMarginMax
parameter.description: Maximum margin for AIC picker window

parameter.name: multipick.aicConfidenceThreshold
parameter.description: Confidence threshold for enhanced AIC picker (0.0-1.0)

parameter.name: multipick.aicAdaptiveWindows
parameter.description: Enable adaptive windows for enhanced AIC picker

parameter.name: multipick.aicMultiBand
parameter.description: Enable multi-band processing for enhanced AIC picker

parameter.name: multipick.aicNumBands
parameter.description: Number of bands for multi-band AIC picker

parameter.name: amplitudes
parameter.description: The amplitude types to be computed by the picker based on picks

parameter.name: enableUpdate
parameter.description: Configure a list of magnitude types. Update and send amplitudes for these magnitudes as soon as data are available. Do not wait for complete time windows. Only magnitudes computed by scmultipick as given by the amplitudes parameter are considered. This option is for rapid magnitude estimation and EEW.

parameter.name: minSNR
parameter.description: Global minimum SNR for amplitude processors (fallback)

parameter.name: fx
parameter.description: Configures the feature extraction type to use. Currently available: "DFX"

parameter.name: interpolateGaps
parameter.description: Enables/disables gap interpolation

parameter.name: sendDetections
parameter.description: If enabled and a picker is configured, then initial detections are sent as well

parameter.name: extraPickComments
parameter.description: If enabled and a picker or spicker is configured, extra comments will be added to the resulting pick

parameter.name: playback
parameter.description: Accept historic data in real-time playbacks

parameter.name: simplifiedIDs
parameter.description: If enabled then simplified pick and amplitude IDs will be created

parameter.name: amplitudeGroup
parameter.description: Message group for sending amplitudes to

group.name: comment
group.description: Properties of a custom comment added to a pick

parameter.name: ID
parameter.description: The ID of a custom comment

parameter.name: text
parameter.description: The text of a custom comment

option.description: Do not use the database at all
Do not connect to a messaging server and do not use the database

Switches to playback mode which does not request a particular time window from the input data source. This implies that all records are forwarded to scmultipick if files are being used. Without this option scmultipick would not work anymore with older datasets in offline mode or when running playbacks.
Outputs an XML event parameters file containing all picks and amplitudes. This option implies '--offline'. Consider '--playback' or configure accordingly for processing data from the past.
Enables or disables computation of amplitudes
Runs the picker as usual but does not send any messages. This can be useful to test the picker within a running system

Dumps the current configuration and exits. Station configuration is only read if the picker connects to the messaging and the database. In offline mode it will only dump the application specific setting unless a station.conf file is provided

This option only works in combination with :option:`--offline`. It will dump the data of an amplitude processor if it completed processing successfully and a new amplitude is available. The output format is a simple ASCII format.
Use formatted XML output along with '--ep'. Otherwise XML is unformatted

binding.description: Configures a station for picking. A station without a binding assigned will not be picked unless the picker is in offline mode.

parameter.name: detecEnable
parameter.description: Enables/disables picking on a station

parameter.name: detecFilter
parameter.summary: Defines the filter to be used for picking
parameter.description: Defines the filter to be used for picking. Station-specific configurations (bindings) override this value.

parameter.name: trigOn
parameter.description: For which value on the filtered waveform is a pick detected

parameter.name: trigOff
parameter.description: The value the filtered waveform must reach to enable a detection again

parameter.name: timeCorr
parameter.description: The time correction applied to a pick

parameter.name: sensitivityCorrection
parameter.description: Defines whether the detector applies sensitivity correction (applying the gain) or not in advance to filter the data

parameter.name: sFilter
parameter.description: S-phase filter (if different from P-phase filter)

parameter.name: sTriggerOn
parameter.description: S-phase trigger on threshold (if different from P-phase)

parameter.name: sTriggerOff
parameter.description: S-phase trigger off threshold (if different from P-phase)

parameter.name: sTimeCorrection
parameter.description: S-phase time correction (if different from P-phase)

parameter.name: sDeadTime
parameter.description: S-phase dead time
